title: ARCH↔BIZ-001: Architecture Decisions with Business Impact + Business Constraints for Architecture
description: The Embedded Systems Architect provides ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) with quantified cost and timeline implications, per-option BOM (Bill of Materials) and NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) cost estimates, technical-feasibility assessments of market-driven feature requests, and hardware lead-time estimates; the Business Consultant provides market requirements translated into system-level constraints (target BOM cost range, connectivity-protocol rationale, certification requirements), business framing of architectural trade-offs, the investment case for NRE-significant decisions, and business-constraint-change notifications. Grounded in EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_ARCHITECT_SKILL §6.13 and BUSINESS_CONSULTANT_SKILL §6.2. The Business Impact Assessment artifact appended to cost-material ADRs is schematized separately as ARCH↔BIZ-BIA-001 (cross-referenced, not duplicated here).

architecture_business_impact.description: ARCH→BIZ: architecture decisions, cost/timeline implications, and feasibility of market-driven requests.

notified_within_business_days.description: ARCH notifies BIZ within 3 business days of ADR acceptance.

business_constraints.description: BIZ→ARCH: market constraints, trade-off framing, investment case, and constraint-change notifications.

tradeoff_framing.description: Business framing of architectural trade-offs (cost/risk/time, e.g., edge vs. cloud compute).

magnitude.description: e.g., BOM ceiling revision >10%, market-window acceleration >1 month.

notified_within_business_days.description: BIZ notifies ARCH within 2 business days of a confirmed change.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Cost- and market-window-material architecture decisions. A cost-material ADR requires a Business Impact Assessment (ADR_SCHEMA V-ADR-12) and ARB ratification when STRATEGIC; the BIA artifact is schematized as ARCH↔BIZ-BIA-001. Binding decisions are ratified by humans.
x-macp.cadence: CALENDAR + TRIGGER (Monthly Business-Architecture Alignment, 2nd Tuesday; ADR #business-impact notification within 3 business days of acceptance; business-constraint-change notification within 2 business days; Quarterly Technology-Business Strategy Session; Pre-Planning Business Input ≥2 weeks before each Planning stage)
confirm_conditions: a cost-material (#business-impact) ADR carries a quantified cost_impact (value + currency) and a timeline_impact
each architecture option's BOM and NRE costs carry value, currency, and (for BOM) an explicit unit
BIZ-supplied constraints (BOM ceiling, certification requirements, trade-off framing) are present where the exchange concerns them
ADR acceptance notified to BIZ within 3 business days; business-constraint changes notified to ARCH within 2 business days
reject_conditions: a cost-material (#business-impact) ADR marked DECIDED without a Business Impact Assessment (V-ADR-12; see ARCH↔BIZ-BIA-001) — escalate
a STRATEGIC ADR with a BIA recommendation = REJECT marked DECIDED without an explicit ARB override (BIA gate)
a BOM cost figure or NRE estimate emitted without an explicit currency/unit (units rule §3.10)
an architecture decision crossing the approved-stack boundary recorded without an ADR (Never Silently Deviate)
counter_conditions: a market-driven feature request lacks an evaluable system-level constraint — request the target BOM/cost/performance envelope before issuing a feasibility verdict
a trade-off option presented without cost/risk/time framing — request the business framing before committing
